business_problem: 10BedICU needed to extend scarce specialist capacity across India's government hospitals, because critical-care demand outstripped available ICU infrastructure and clinicians were burdened by fragmented monitoring and documentation work.
solution_summary: 10BedICU uses OpenAI models to add AI-powered documentation, monitoring, and continuity-of-care workflows on top of its CARE telehealth and EMR platform. CARE already links more than 200 hospitals and supports remote specialist consultations, but the team needed new tools that could help clinicians document visits faster, connect older devices, and summarize long patient histories without compromising privacy or rollout discipline. CARE Scribe combines Whisper API and GPT-4 to transcribe doctor-patient interactions into structured EMR entries in multiple Indian languages, CARE Device Connect uses GPT-4 Vision to pull data from incompatible monitors into the CARE platform in real time, and CARE Discharge Summary uses GPT-4 to summarize records for handoff and discharge. Those flows are piloted with state partners and hospitals under closed feedback loops. The result is an AI layer that helps clinicians spend more time with patients while making the broader care network more capable.

solution_components.name: GPT-4
solution_components.role: Structures clinical conversations and summarizes patient records for documentation workflows.

solution_components.name: CARE Device Connect
solution_components.role: Brings readings from older hospital monitors into the CARE platform for continuous monitoring.

solution_components.name: GPT-4 Vision
solution_components.role: Interprets monitor readings captured by cameras so incompatible devices can feed the platform.

solution_components.name: CARE Discharge Summary
solution_components.role: Automates patient-record summarization for handoffs and continuity-of-care workflows.

data_flow: Audio from doctor-patient interactions flows through Whisper API and GPT-4 into structured CARE EMR entries, monitor data is captured by cameras and interpreted by GPT-4 Vision before entering CARE for live monitoring, and patient histories are summarized by GPT-4 through CARE Discharge Summary for downstream care teams.
business_outcome: 10BedICU expanded what clinicians can do inside underserved hospitals, reduced documentation effort, improved data quality, and laid the groundwork for smarter ICU monitoring across India.
